Bench_Dips: Elbows back, push through your palms.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row: Pull elbows back, squeeze your shoulder blades.
Cable_Crossover: Hug the cables, squeeze your chest together.
Concentration_Curls: Elbow still, squeeze the bicep at top.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press: Squeeze your chest, slow on the way down.
Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl: Elbows pinned, curl with the biceps only.
Dumbbell_Flyes: Wide arc, feel the chest stretch.
Dumbbell_Seated_One-Leg_Calf_Raise: Full stretch, pause at the top.
Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press: Press straight up, brace your core.
Dumbbell_Step_Ups: Push through the top leg only.
Face_Pull: Pull to your face, elbows high.
Goblet_Squat: Chest up, sit down between your knees.
Hammer_Curls: Thumbs up, elbows quiet, slow down.
Incline_Dumbbell_Curl: Arms hang back, feel the long stretch.
Incline_Dumbbell_Press: Upper chest drives it, slow lowering.
Leg_Extensions: Squeeze the quads hard at the top.
Leg_Press: Control the lowering, push through heels.
Lying_Leg_Curls: Hips down, curl with your hamstrings.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row: Elbow to hip, squeeze your back.
Pushups: Body straight, chest to the floor.
Reverse_Flyes: Lead with elbows, squeeze rear shoulders.
Seated_Cable_Rows: Chest tall, pull elbows behind you.
Side_Lateral_Raise: Lead with elbows, raise to shoulder height.
Standing_Calf_Raises: Full stretch down, pause at the top.
Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension: Elbows in, stretch deep behind your head.
Stiff-Legged_Dumbbell_Deadlift: Hips back, feel the hamstring stretch.
Triceps_Pushdown: Elbows pinned, lock out and squeeze.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown: Pull elbows down, chest up to bar.
